question_text: A foreign investor wants to acquire a 5-hectare residential lot in Tagaytay for personal use. Under Article XII of the 1987 Philippine Constitution, which of the following statements best describes the legality of this acquisition?

options.text: The foreign investor may acquire the lot because the Constitution allows foreign ownership of land for residential purposes up to 10 hectares.
The foreign investor may acquire the lot only if he becomes a naturalized Filipino citizen.
The foreign investor cannot acquire the lot because the Constitution generally prohibits foreign ownership of private lands, with exceptions only for former natural-born Filipinos.
The foreign investor may acquire the lot through a long-term lease of up to 50 years, renewable for another 25 years, but not ownership.
